title: Consolidate CommandCenterUI rapid-feedback edits into one reviewable final state
description: Reconcile the serial operator-feedback implementations recorded as TASK-241 through TASK-248 into one independently reviewable final-state batch. Preserve each original timeline, retire the overwritten snapshot cards as superseded, establish one active owner for the shared live/template UI files and focused tests, verify the combined requirements and parity, and make no UI behavior change during reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: TASK-241 through TASK-248 are preserved in history and explicitly superseded by TASK-254 rather than presented as eight independently recoverable worktree snapshots.
Exactly one active task owns the live/template chat HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and the focused tests covering all eight operator feedback changes.
The final-state packet maps every original acceptance criterion to current code/test evidence and records live/template parity, JavaScript syntax, and focused test results.
Task graph and task mirrors validate after reconciliation, and no CommandCenterUI source or behavior is changed by the administrative repair.
